headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea eye ex-Liverpool star Wijnaldum
description: Chelsea have made contact with former Liverpool midfielder Georginio Wijnaldum. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mike Dean admits to playing secret 'game' to not blow whistle while refereeing Premier League matches
description: Former Premier League referee Mike Dean has revealed he used to play secret "games" while refereeing top-flight matches, including one where he tried to avoid giving a foul for as long as possible.

headline: Hull condemn 'abhorrent' racist abuse directed towards deadline-day signing Robinio Vaz
description: Hull City have condemned the racist abuse directed towards new signing Robinio Vaz on social media.

headline: Andoni Iraola: Bradley Barcola could make Liverpool debut against Ipswich
description: Andoni Iraola has said new signing Bradley Barcola could make his Liverpool debut in Friday's Premier League clash with Ipswich Town.

headline: Michael Carrick explains why he doesn't like to play in Man United training
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has said that he doesn't like to take to the pitch in training, preferring to oversee his sessions from the sidelines.
